script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Your ruling planet Neptune in Aries is forming a harmonious sextile with Venus in Gemini, bridging your 2nd House of finances and 4th House of home foundations. Neptune, your spiritual ruler and guardian of the Water element, anchors this aspect. This water-and-air dance infuses your sensitive Water element with communicative sparks that soften old resentments. Singles, this transit attracts a witty Air-sign lover through a family gathering or shared living space; taken Pisces, watch for superficial chatter masking deeper needs in your 7th House of partnership tonight. In your 10th House of career, Mars in Leo trines Neptune, offering a creative breakthrough that could boost your income stream if you pitch boldly to authority figures. Blessing: an unexpected refund or gift arrives from a female mentor before sunset, healing a money wound. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
